title: About Me
text:
Hello! My name is Brady Crebbe, and I am an Industrial Engineering and Operations Analytics student at the University of Arkansas.
I enjoy solving problems, working with data, and finding ways to make systems more efficient. Through my coursework, job experience, and school projects I have been developing skills in programming, statistics, and process improvement while building a strong foundation in engineering principles.
This portfolio showcases projects, coursework, and experiences that have contributed to my growth as a student and future engineer. I look forward to continuing to learn and applying these skills in professional settings.
